svg.desc: Each hazard's mitigations by MIL-STD-882E order of precedence (a: eliminate hazard through design selection; b: reduce risk through design alteration; c: incorporate engineered features or devices; d: provide warning devices; e: incorporate signage), with the preliminary initial and target risk. 59 identified.

svg.text: Generated by tools/previews/record_figures.py from safety/hazards/HAZ-*.yaml and standards/mil-std-882e/model.yaml. Drafted at independence level I0; nothing shown here is reviewed, verified or

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · DoD = US
Department of Defense · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g.
the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record (M1, M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard
Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · SysML = Systems Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
